verses.he: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.ar: اِهْتِفُوا أَيُّهَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ بِٱلرَّبِّ. بِٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ يَلِيقُ ٱلتَّسْبِيحُ.
verses.en: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous, praise is comely for the upright.
verses.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: [for] praise is comely for the upright.
verses.web: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

verses.he: הֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנֹּ֑ור בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שֹׂ֗ור זַמְּרוּ־לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ بِٱلْعُودِ. بِرَبَابَةٍ ذَاتِ عَشَرَةِ أَوْتَارٍ رَنِّمُوا لَهُ.
verses.en: Give thanks unto the LORD with harp, sing praises unto Him with the psaltery of ten strings.
verses.kjv: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery [and] an instrument of ten strings.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

verses.he: שִֽׁירוּ־לֹ֖ו שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.ar: غَنُّوا لَهُ أُغْنِيَةً جَدِيدَةً. أَحْسِنُوا ٱلْعَزْفَ بِهُتَافٍ.
verses.en: Sing unto Him a new song; play skilfully amid shouts of joy.
verses.kjv: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.web: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

verses.he: כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ كَلِمَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ مُسْتَقِيمَةٌ، وَكُلَّ صُنْعِهِ بِٱلْأَمَانَةِ.
verses.en: For the word of the LORD is upright; and all His work is done in faithfulness.
verses.kjv: For the word of the LORD [is] right; and all his works [are done] in truth.
verses.web: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

verses.he: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: يُحِبُّ ٱلْبِرَّ وَٱلْعَدْلَ. ٱمْتَلَأَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: He loveth righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the lovingkindness of the LORD.
verses.kjv: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
verses.web: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

verses.he: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל־צְבָאָֽם׃
verses.ar: بِكَلِمَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ صُنِعَتِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ، وَبِنَسَمَةِ فِيهِ كُلُّ جُنُودِهَا.
verses.en: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.
verses.kjv: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.web: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

verses.he: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָרֹ֣ות תְּהֹומֹֽות׃
verses.ar: يَجْمَعُ كَنَدٍّ أَمْوَاهَ ٱلْيَمِّ. يَجْعَلُ ٱللُّجَجَ فِي أَهْرَاءٍ.
verses.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap; He layeth up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.web: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

verses.he: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.ar: لِتَخْشَ ٱلرَّبَّ كُلُّ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْهُ لِيَخَفْ كُلُّ سُكَّانِ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ.
verses.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
verses.kjv: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.web: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־צִ֝וָּ֗ה וֽ͏ַיַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ قَالَ فَكَانَ. هُوَ أَمَرَ فَصَارَ.
verses.en: For He spoke, and it was; He commanded, and it stood.
verses.kjv: For he spake, and it was [done;] he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.web: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־גֹּויִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁבֹ֥ות עַמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ أَبْطَلَ مُؤَامَرَةَ ٱلْأُمَمِ. لَاشَى أَفْكَارَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ.
verses.en: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.kjv: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.web: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

verses.he: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעֹולָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁבֹ֥ות לִ֝בֹּ֗ו לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا مُؤَامَرَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ فَإِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ تَثْبُتُ. أَفْكَارُ قَلْبِهِ إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.en: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of His heart to all generations.
verses.kjv: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.web: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גֹּוי אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם ׀ בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلْأُمَّةِ ٱلَّتِي ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُهَا، ٱلشَّعْبِ ٱلَّذِي ٱخْتَارَهُ مِيرَاثًا لِنَفْسِهِ.
verses.en: Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD; the people whom He hath chosen for His own inheritance.
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] the LORD; [and] the people [whom] he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.web: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ نَظَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ. رَأَى جَمِيعَ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ.
verses.en: The LORD looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;
verses.kjv: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.web: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

verses.he: מִֽמְּכֹון־שִׁבְתֹּ֥ו הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: مِنْ مَكَانِ سُكْنَاهُ تَطَلَّعَ إِلَى جَمِيعِ سُكَّانِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: From the place of His habitation He looketh intently upon all the inhabitants of the earth;
verses.kjv: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.web: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

verses.he: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ قُلُوبَهُمْ جَمِيعًا، ٱلْمُنْتَبِهُ إِلَى كُلِّ أَعْمَالِهِمْ.
verses.en: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, that considereth all their doings.
verses.kjv: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.web: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

verses.he: אֵֽין־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נֹושָׁ֣ע בְּרָב־חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בֹּ֗ור לֹֽא־יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב־כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.ar: لَنْ يَخْلُصَ ٱلْمَلِكُ بِكِثْرَةِ ٱلْجَيْشِ. ٱلْجَبَّارُ لَا يُنْقَذُ بِعِظَمِ ٱلْقُوَّةِ.
verses.en: A king is not saved by the multitude of a host; a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.kjv: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.web: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

verses.he: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝ילֹ֗ו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.ar: بَاطِلٌ هُوَ ٱلْفَرَسُ لِأَجْلِ ٱلْخَلَاصِ، وَبِشِدَّةِ قُوَّتِهِ لَا يُنَجِّي.
verses.en: A horse is a vain thing for safety; neither doth it afford escape by its great strength.
verses.kjv: An horse [is] a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver [any] by his great strength.
verses.web: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

verses.he: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: هُوَذَا عَيْنُ ٱلرَّبِّ عَلَى خَائِفِيهِ ٱلرَّاجِينَ رَحْمَتَهُ،
verses.en: Behold, the eye of the LORD is toward them that fear Him, toward them that wait for His mercy;
verses.kjv: Behold, the eye of the LORD [is] upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.web: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

verses.he: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיֹּותָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.ar: لِيُنَجِّيَ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَنْفُسَهُمْ، وَلِيَسْتَحْيِيَهُمْ فِي ٱلْجُوعِ.
verses.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.kjv: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.web: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

verses.he: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: أَنْفُسُنَا ٱنْتَظَرَتِ ٱلرَّبَّ. مَعُونَتُنَا وَتُرْسُنَا هُوَ.
verses.en: Our soul hath waited for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
verses.kjv: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he [is] our help and our shield.
verses.web: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

verses.he: כִּי־בֹ֭ו יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשֹׁ֣ו בָטָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ بِهِ تَفْرَحُ قُلُوبُنَا، لِأَنَّنَا عَلَى ٱسْمِهِ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ ٱتَّكَلْنَا.
verses.en: For in Him doth our heart rejoice, because we have trusted in His holy name.
verses.kjv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.web: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.he: יְהִֽי־חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: لِتَكُنْ يَارَبُّ رَحْمَتُكَ عَلَيْنَا حَسْبَمَا ٱنْتَظَرْنَاكَ.
verses.en: Let Thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we have waited for Thee.
verses.kjv: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.web: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
